title: docs(qa): re-point error-sentences acceptance[1] to HOOK_ABORTED
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"marchtian"} -->
_Requested by **田騏** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01VmuUhXU9SSUzqJYyXSmYSi?thread=cmsg_01VmuUhXU9SSUzqJYyXSmYSi9paTx1Lu8ENYwwssthfK3h)_

Fixes #28936

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:只改测试清单 `api-backend.error-sentences-and-unique-violation-wire-code` 一项的 acceptance[1](条款与核验文字)和 `automated.ref` 说明,revision 5 → 6,加一条 history;不动任何产品代码。
- 为什么改:产品早已按裁决给"钩子未声明错误码的拒绝"回 `HOOK_ABORTED`,清单却还写着"没有 code / VALIDATION_ERROR",每次发版 QA 都把一个正确的产品判成 FAIL,假红会让跑测的人学会忽略这一项。
- 风险与回滚:只是文档账本,风险极低;回滚即 revert 本 PR。条款从"断言没有 code"变成"断言 code 等于 HOOK_ABORTED",只更严不更松。
- 先看:`docs/qa/platform-checklist/areas/api-backend.json` 里该项的 acceptance[1] 两段文字,以及末尾新增的 revision 6 history 行。
- 两分钟验证:在本分支跑 `pnpm check:platform-checklist`,预期末行打印 `check-platform-checklist: OK — 16 areas, 352 items`。
- 需要你做的:无,席位落地。

## What changes

One item in one file, `docs/qa/platform-checklist/areas/api-backend.json`, item `api-backend.error-sentences-and-unique-violation-wire-code`:

- **acceptance[1].clause** — the /data door's answer to a hook that declared no code is now the ledgered ADR-0112 code `HOOK_ABORTED` (`UNDECLARED_HOOK_REFUSAL_CODE`, #27597), never a code-less 400 and never the status-derived `VALIDATION_ERROR`; the hand-built nested-envelope rows (sharing rules, suggested bindings, approvals, package publish) answer 400 `HOOK_ABORTED` with the hook's sentence (package publish through `resolveThrownHttpError`, #27672). Status (400, not 500) and sentence are unchanged.
- **acceptance[1].verify** — the live pin asserts `code` equal to `HOOK_ABORTED` (was: no `code` key); the unit pin asserts `HOOK_ABORTED` and no `declaredCode` through `mapDataError`; the ledger pin's rows are `HOOK_ABORTED_400` in its §2 (the old `REFUSED_400` name no longer exists in that file).
- **automated.ref** prose — "400 with no code on the /data doors" becomes "400 with code HOOK_ABORTED", and it says the two rest pins also hold acceptance[1]'s code below HTTP. The five pin paths are unchanged.
- `revision` 5 → 6, one `history` row citing QA run #28929 and this card. Main's five history rows are kept as an exact prefix; no other item, and no other field of this item, changed.

The clause is narrower, not weaker: it used to accept an absent code, and now it demands one specific code.

## Tests

Docs-only ledger edit; no product or test file changed, so no package test is owed (`skip-changeset`: nothing under any package's `files[]` moved).

Where each new statement comes from, read at base `135054ebaa` and unchanged at head:

- `HOOK_ABORTED` is in the ADR-0112 ledger: `packages/spec/src/api/error-code-ledger.zod.ts`, with its #27597 comment.
- `UNDECLARED_HOOK_REFUSAL_CODE = 'HOOK_ABORTED'`: `packages/types/src/thrown-http-error.ts`; stamped on the /data door by `sandboxRefusalCodeFields` in `packages/types/src/data-error-classification.ts`, and by `resolveThrownHttpError` for the doors #27672 converged.
- Live pin `packages/qa/dogfood/test/error-sentences-live.dogfood.test.ts`: both /data doors assert 400, `body.error` equal to the sentence, `body.code` equal to `HOOK_ABORTED`, zero rows.
- Unit pin `packages/rest/src/rest-hook-script-fault-envelope.test.ts`: `mapDataError` answers `HOOK_ABORTED` and has no `declaredCode`.
- Ledger pin `packages/rest/src/rest-write-route-hook-refusal-sentence.ledger.test.ts`: `HOOK_ABORTED_400 = { status: 400, code: 'HOOK_ABORTED' }` on every sharing-rule, suggested-binding, approval and package-publish row.
- The three pins, the dogfood fixture, and the three source files above (`thrown-http-error.ts`, `data-error-classification.ts`, `packages/rest/src/package-routes.ts`) are byte-identical between the QA run subject `7fa9873f` (where #28929 ran both pins green, twice) and this head: `git diff --stat 7fa9873f HEAD` over the seven files is empty.

## Acceptance notes

- The triage notes the item is missing from the `docs/NORTH-STAR.md` ladder rows. It is: no ladder row names `api-backend.error-sentences-and-unique-violation-wire-code`. `docs/NORTH-STAR.md` is a separate, governed file, outside this card's one-item surface, so it is left for the seat.
- The ledger pin still has one `VALIDATION_ERROR` row by design: a sandboxed refusal that DID declare a code (`MZ_LOCKED`) rides the nested envelope as `VALIDATION_ERROR` plus `declaredCode`. acceptance[1] covers only a hook that declared none, so the new clause does not say "no VALIDATION_ERROR anywhere".
- The pins were not re-run locally. The diff changes no tested behaviour, and the files are byte-identical to the subject where #28929 measured them green.
